DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 68 s. 2022 JUL 22 2022 HON. EMERSON LUEGO Mayor Municipality of Mabini, Davao de Oro Dear Mayor Luego: This has reference to the letter-reply dated 26 April 2022 of former Mayor Reynaldo Dayanghirang to Diane Erica C. Jogno, Assistant Vice President, E-Sabong Licensing Department, wherein she was seeking clarification on whether a special permit has been issued by former Mayor Dayanghirang to CM Mabini Gallera for the conduct of e-sabong during Holy Thursday and Good Friday (April 14 and 15 2022). The Department was furnished a copy of former Dayanghirang's letter-reply. Per Mayor Dayanghirang's letter, he explained that no permit was ever issued to CM Mabini Gallera to conduct e-sabong fights on such dates. In addition, he provided as background information that an errand of said Gallera came to pay permit fee directly at the LGU's Office of the Municipal Treasurer for the conduct of e-sabong/derby scheduled on 14 and 15 April 2022. Then, on the basis of such official receipt, said errand went to apply for a permit at the Licensing Office wherein such person was informed the cockfight prohibition on Holy Thursday and Good Friday under PD 449, and to re-schedule the derby on another date, and if not, ask the Municipal Treasurer's office to refund his payment. Thereafter, no communication of any kind was given by CM Gallera. At the outset, we would like to highlight that the Supreme Court made a pronouncement in the case of Tan vs. Pereal, that while Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991, now governs as to the authority of the Sangguniang Bayan to authorize or license establishment, operation, and maintenance of cockpits, it is still subject to the limitations laid down in Presidential Decree No. 449, otherwise known as the Cockfighting Law of 1974. The Court even said that "there is no dichotomy between affirming the power and subjecting it to limitations at the same time. " Accordingly, we would like to emphasize that while the local government units (LGUs) enjoy local autonomy and are empowered to issue the necessary permits within their jurisdiction, pursuant to the Republic Act No. 7160 or known as the "Local Government Code of 1991", however, it must, at all times, make sure compliance with existing laws and orders of the national government. I G.R. No. 149743, February 18, 2005. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline Noa: 8876-34-54

Correspondingly, we deem it proper to highlight the directive of President Rodrigo Roa Duterte, last 04 May 2022, to suspend the operations of e-sabong nationwide, based on the recommendation of this Department, until a better set of framework and regulations are formulated, in such a way that it will not significantly harm any of the stakeholders or lead to the moral decay of society. In view of the foregoing, the concemed officials of the Municipality of Mabini, Province of Davao de Oro, are hereby enjoined to make the appropriate action to address this incident, wherein an official receipt was issued for a permit for e-sabong, and that e- sabong operations were still conducted within its jurisdiction in violation of PD 449, considering that LGUs must ensure that its acts and procedures are consistent with the pertinent issuances and directives of the national government. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: NGAN Underse ry for Local Govemment OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/rjWclp copy furnished: DIRECTOR ARIEL O.
